confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on search summaries citing Numbeo's Jeonju entries (about six contributors) and scaled-down Korea-wide and Seoul aggregator prices. Beer, coffee and the budget meal agree closely across sources, while the two-person mid-range meal varies widely. Cocktail is set near the low end of Seoul house-cocktail ranges. Wine by the glass follows the local beer relationship (roughly twice the beer anchor) because direct Jeonju wine data is thin. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge for July-season levels; no accommodation search or listing check was run. KRW prices were converted at about 1,467 won per USD, a July 23, 2026 closing rate cited in a search result, to match the July pricing window. A November rate near 1,333 would have produced higher USD figures.
comparable_city_reasoning: Jeonju-specific Numbeo restaurant entries, cross-checked against Korea-wide and Seoul aggregator prices and scaled down for Jeonju (Numbeo's Seoul comparison puts Jeonju restaurant prices about 39.5% below Seoul). Accommodation uses general knowledge of regional Korean hostel, budget inn and hotel rates.
